name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-12-15, at wavelengths from 1.19 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
